scope: Windows Exchange file-sharing race; no real API or scientific run

initial_failure_retained.first_error: PermissionError [Errno 13] in synthetic answer thread reading the newly published request
initial_failure_retained.consequence: The thread never published its response; ExchangeAdapter.wait reached its unchanged 10-second deadline

finding: Both request posting and the real CLI response writer already used same-directory temporary files followed by os.replace. Atomic publication alone does not guarantee immediate readability under a transient Windows sharing lock.
changes: ExchangeAdapter.wait retries FileNotFoundError and PermissionError inside its original deadline; permanent JSON errors are not converted into retries
CLI bridge next handles a transient PermissionError inside its existing wait loop and retries owned work before claiming additional requests
The existing round-trip synthetic consumer uses bounded read retries and atomically publishes the response, matching the real bridge writer
The same round-trip deterministically injects one request and one response sharing error and asserts both were handled

verification.reason: Rechecked the affected command after preventing an unreadable owned request from causing additional claims

runtime_scope: The live reduction retained its already loaded implementation and original source archive. This correction applies to subsequent processes only.
